item.summary: fix(ui): stop stamping a dead blur class on chat links containing 'tail' (#123154) The DOMPurify afterSanitizeAttributes hook added class chat-link-tail-blur to every rendered chat link whose href merely contains the substring "tail" (docs.openclaw.ai/tailscale, /details/, retail, ...). No stylesheet or script anywhere consumes the class: it is an orphaned producer that survived the Control UI import, polluting sanitized HTML and the markdown LRU cache, and priming a foot-gun where any future .chat-link-tail-blur CSS rule would visually blur docs links in every transcript. Link presentation classes are owned by markdown-parser.ts (web-link-classes, hostname-based); delete the substring classifier.
